{{Top|leg}}
The '''Nilash Imperial Impound Facility''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] impound base at [[Nilash III]] in the [[Nilash system/Legends|Nilash system]]. It was commonly patrolled by [[Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighter/Legends|V-wing fighters]]. The [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] (then named the ''Second Chance'') was held here.
